connector.name: FileToPDF
connector.registryDescription: Convert files, HTML, and Markdown to PDF via the FileToPDF API. Bring your own API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.filetopdf.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package filetopdf-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.filetopdf, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
